text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap has been struggling with exhaustion, so I bring her to the infirmary to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks for everything. I'll do as you suggest and relax for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn… All that food must have made me sleepy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry… I'm just gonna take… a little nap…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where am I? I thought I was at the academy…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …What? Is that the statue of the Three Goddesses? Maybe not… They look pretty real.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It's wild out here in the city. They've got goddesses roaming around and everything. Wait until I tell everyone back home about this… Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: They're waving at me. Are they… telling me to chase them?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I guess… they want to race me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No problem! I'd be more than happy to accept the challenge! Here I come, goddesses!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, wait. This is… the infirmary? Hm… I must have been dreaming.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That was fun though. I couldn't catch up to them, but I felt like I could run forever and ever without getting tired.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Heh, I feel kind of refreshed now. Maybe a good rest was what I needed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having regained her energy, Oguri Cap leaves the infirmary with a spring in her step.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh?! …The infirmary? So it was just a dream.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Who would have guessed the Three Goddesses would turn into a big bowl of stew while running?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I was literally knocked off my feet. Sigh… If only I could have had a small taste before waking up… Just one tiny sip…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fixated on her stew dream, Oguri Cap is unable to get the rest she needs.
